A.title: Case A: real snapshot data, no indicator changed (actual situation)

B.title: Case B [HYPOTHETICAL SHOCK - not a forecast]: A05 'Brent above 110 $ for more than two quarters' switched ON

C.title: Case C [HYPOTHETICAL SHOCK - not a forecast]: A13 'Brent below 70 $' switched ON

sources.k: model/world_model.de.json : bayes.k_daempfung (line 2064, value 0.15); read by engine/tagesstand.py rechne_am() (line 262). Overridden here on an in-memory copy only.
sources.base_exact: model/world_model.de.json : zufluss.p_basis[h] (prior used on the active path)
sources.rounded: engine/tagesstand.py tagesstand() [case A] or aus_status() [B, C] -> rechne_am() -> engine/bayes.py update_probabilities() -> _update_zufluss() -> largest_remainder(); field p_tag
sources.exact: engine/tagesstand.py rechne_am() -> engine/bayes.py _update_zufluss() -> engine/zufluss.py posterior() / untergrenze(); field posterior_exakt (before rounding)
sources.status: engine/tagesstand.py tagesstand() -> pruefe() / gilt() / stufen.stufe(); anzeichen[].stufe_basis, stufe_jetzt
sources.lr: engine/bayes.py log_likelihoods() + coupling_mean() (exp taken), weight from engine/zufluss.py gewichte(); returned in weltlage signale[].likelihood / .gewicht
sources.regime: model/world_model.de.json : szenarien[].regime.energy_price, summed per level in this script (same rule as domains/lens.py scenarios())
sources.names: model/world_model.en.json : szenarien[].name (English labels only; numbers come from the .de file)
sources.metrics: computed in this script from the values above

meta.note: Cases B and C are HYPOTHETICAL shocks used to test the formula; they are not forecasts.
